cards.name: Focus Blur
cards.summary: Keeps an elliptical (or linear) focus area sharp and lens-blurs everything outside it, with feathered falloff, bokeh highlight gain and chromatic fringing, to steer the eye to the subject.
use_for: isolate one leader in a group press shot or podium line-up
fake shallow depth of field on flat phone or news footage
tilt-shift miniature look on aerial rally / city shots (only if Focus Type 1 is the linear band: render-check)
defocus the background behind a lower-third or quote card
animated focus pull to reveal the subject in a trailer
avoid: focus area that does not follow a moving subject: track or keyframe Position
hard edges (low Feather) look like a cheap cut-out
very high Chromatic Aberration looks like a broken lens

params.name: Focus Type
params.does: shape of the sharp area (dropdown 0..1); 0 default = spot/ellipse using Width/Height/Roundness, 1 assumed linear tilt-shift band

params.name: Position
params.does: centre of the sharp area (frame fractions)

params.name: Feather
params.does: softness of the transition from sharp to blurred

params.name: Gain
params.does: boosts bright highlights in the blur into bokeh balls

params.name: Chromatic Aberration
params.does: colour fringing in the blurred zone

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Gaussian Blur with an inverted, feathered effect mask; After Effects: Camera Lens Blur with a radial-gradient blur map
cards.scripting: Film Impact effect built into Premiere 2026 (match AE.Impact_*; Film Impact Dashboard catalog lists it). Header bools that repeat a name (e.g. 'Light Controls', 'Pre Transform', 'Motion Controls') are group open/close markers: never set them. Focus Type labels are not harvested (0..1); keep 0 unless render-checked. Angle rotates the focus shape, Roundness 100 = ellipse, lower = rounded rectangle (assumed). Scale (0..200) resizes the whole focus shape. Seed only changes noise/bokeh randomness. Position does not follow the subject: keyframe it or apply to a tracked adjustment layer.

verified.note: Centre ellipse around the middle of the frame stays sharp while stripes, foreground blocks and frame edges are lens-blurred, with bokeh blooms on the small lamps at right.

cards.name: Glint
cards.summary: Adds animated star / cross-shaped glints and shimmer to the brightest highlights of the clip, with control over star shape, size, colour and chromatic fringing.
use_for: sparkle on trophies, medals, jewellery, gold or chrome logos
celebration / victory montage shots with bright lights
shiny title or logo reveal in a trailer or channel intro
night city lights or stage lights for an energetic reel
avoid: on faces or skin highlights it looks cheesy
noisy or flickery footage makes the glints flicker
low Highlights Only on bright daylight shots covers the frame in stars

params.name: Highlights Only
params.does: brightness threshold: higher = only the brightest highlights glint

params.name: Cross Scale
params.does: size of the secondary cross rays

params.name: Colorize
params.does: how much the Color tints the glints

cards.equivalent: Glow (After Effects has no native star glint; Trapcode Starglow is the usual third-party match)
cards.scripting: Film Impact effect built into Premiere 2026 (match AE.Impact_*; Film Impact Dashboard catalog lists it). Header bools that repeat a name (e.g. 'Light Controls', 'Pre Transform', 'Motion Controls') are group open/close markers: never set them. Glints are found automatically from the image highlights, so a dark frame shows little: lower 'Highlights Only' first. Shimmer animates by itself (Shimmer Speed); Variation Speed animates the colour. Blend Mode is a 0..1 dropdown with unharvested labels. Specular adds extra hot-spots; Position/Feather appear to limit where glints show (default centre, wide feather) - unverified. Seed changes the random twinkle pattern. Colour default decoded from the 64-bit harvest value as about #FFC36E.

verified.note: Star/cross-shaped ray glints burst from the small lamps, flowers, faces and bright wall areas, with an overall soft glow haze over the frame.

cards.name: Grow
cards.summary: Self-animating scale-up: the clip grows from Initial Scale to Target Scale (or keeps growing at a % per second rate) around an anchor, with easing curves and motion blur, i.e. a one-click Ken Burns push-in.
use_for: slow push-in on still photos and archive images in documentaries
punch-in on a speaker for emphasis in news/explainer reels
keep static B-roll alive under VO
pop-in of a logo or graphic with overshoot
avoid: growing low-resolution photos far past 150% shows softness
big fast zooms on every shot feel like a template
anchor left at centre when the subject is off-centre pushes the subject out of frame

params.name: Initial Scale
params.does: scale (%) at the start of the animation

params.name: Target Scale
params.does: scale (%) at the end of the animation

params.name: Anchor
params.does: point the zoom grows toward (frame fractions)

params.name: Mode
params.does: two modes per Film Impact keywords, Continuous (grows from Initial Scale at Grow (%/s)) and Destination (Initial -> Target Scale); index order unverified, 0 may be Continuous

params.name: Grow (%/s)
params.does: growth rate for the continuous mode

cards.equivalent: Transform effect / Motion Scale keyframes with easing (After Effects: layer Scale keyframes)
cards.scripting: Film Impact effect built into Premiere 2026 (match AE.Impact_*; Film Impact Dashboard catalog lists it). Header bools that repeat a name (e.g. 'Light Controls', 'Pre Transform', 'Motion Controls') are group open/close markers: never set them. Self-animating: the effect tweens from the Initial value to the Target value on its own, so no keyframes are needed (recipe left empty). Mode 0..1 labels were not harvested. Film Impact's catalog keywords name the two modes 'continuous' (runs from the Initial value at the per-second rate) and 'destination' (Initial -> Target over the Effect Timing window), in that order, so 0 (default) may well be Continuous; the index order is unverified. Set Mode explicitly and also set the per-second rate to something sane, so the result is acceptable whichever mode index is live; render-check the first and last frame. 'Type' 0..3 picks the curve family, but there are five parameter groups for its four values: Ease In/Ease Out/Anticipate/Overshoot, Frequency/Amplitude/Decay, Anticipate#2/Bounces/Initial Velocity/Elasticity, Ease Peak/Ease Base/Center and Frequency#2/Phase Shift/Decay#2, so the mapping is unverified. The first 'Scale' is the Pre Transform scale (default 50, meaning not verified): leave it at default. 'Curve Graph' is a string and cannot be set. Demo starts at Initial Scale 130 with a slow 3 %/s rate so the frame is visibly zoomed at any time, whatever Mode or Effect Timing does.

verified.note: Whole clip is scaled up about 130% around the centre (stripes and foreground blocks pushed out toward the frame edges), a clean push-in.

cards.name: Light Leaks
cards.summary: Generates animated, film-style light leaks (coloured strikes and soft spots of light) over the clip, with spectrum, hue, diffraction and blend controls and a Master amount.
use_for: flash of light to hide or sell a cut in a reel or trailer
warm nostalgic look on flashback / archive segments
energetic title or channel intro
celebration or victory montage moments
avoid: serious news, tragedy or hard political reporting: it reads as playful or promotional
Master at 100 for long stretches washes out faces and text
same leak on every cut quickly looks cheap

params.name: Master
params.does: overall amount of the leak (fade it in and out)

params.name: Strike Amount
params.does: strength of the long light streaks

params.name: Spot Amount
params.does: strength of the soft round light spots

params.name: Position
params.does: where the light comes from (frame fractions)

params.name: Color Spectrum
params.does: colour palette preset (dropdown 0..2, labels not harvested)

cards.equivalent: no native one-click match. Premiere: the Film Impact 'Light Leak' transition, or stock light-leak footage in Screen/Add; After Effects: Lens Flare + colourised Fractal Noise in Screen mode
cards.scripting: Film Impact effect built into Premiere 2026 (match AE.Impact_*; Film Impact Dashboard catalog lists it). cards.name: Long Shadow
cards.summary: Casts a long, flat-design extruded shadow from the alpha edges of text, logos or cut-outs at a chosen angle and length, with colourise, two-colour gradient and alpha falloff.
use_for: bold flat-design titles and numbers in explainer graphics
give logos or icons depth in channel intros
stat cards and big headline words in news reels
cut-out leader PNGs on a plain background
avoid: full-frame opaque footage: the shadow falls behind the frame and nothing shows
very long dark shadows on busy backgrounds hurt legibility
mixing shadow angles across elements in one frame

params.name: Colorize
params.does: 100 = solid Shadow Color, lower lets the layer's own colours smear into the shadow (assumed)

params.name: Duo Color
params.does: second colour for a gradient along the shadow

params.name: Duo Amount
params.does: strength of the Duo Color gradient

params.name: Alpha Falloff
params.does: fades the shadow out along its length

cards.equivalent: no native Premiere match (Drop Shadow only gives a short offset shadow); After Effects: Radial Shadow, or a Drop Shadow repeated with Echo

verified.note: Card status is needs_input, so no frame was rendered.

cards.name: Mosaic
cards.summary: Turns the image into a grid of square or hexagonal tiles, with optional bevel lighting, rounded tiles, distortion and coloured grout strokes; the modern replacement for Mosaic (Legacy).
use_for: censor a face, number plate or document (with an effect mask, tracked)
pixel-reveal or pixel-out transition on beats
hexagon tech texture for AI / data explainers
stylised background behind titles
avoid: more than ~25-30 tiles across the frame can leave a face or plate readable: check the censor at full size
censoring without tracking the mask lets the face slip out
heavy Light Amount bevels look dated

params.name: Num. Tiles
params.does: number of tiles across the frame (fewer = bigger blocks)

params.name: Shape
params.does: tile shape dropdown 0..1 (0 default = square, 1 assumed hexagon)

cards.scripting: Film Impact effect built into Premiere 2026 (match AE.Impact_*; Film Impact Dashboard catalog lists it). Header bools that repeat a name (e.g. 'Light Controls', 'Pre Transform', 'Motion Controls') are group open/close markers: never set them. For censoring, add an effect mask (ellipse) on this effect and track it; the effect itself covers the whole clip. Shape labels not harvested (keyword list mentions hexagons). Light Angle/Tile Height shape the bevel; Stroke Color default black. Distortion warps the grid. Do not confuse with the 'Mosaic' transition or 'Mosaic (Legacy)' effect.

verified.note: Image becomes a grid of about 40 square tiles across with dark grout lines and a slight bevel; faces are unreadable.

cards.name: Move
cards.summary: Self-animating position move: slides the clip or graphic from Initial Position to Target Position (or continuously in a Direction at a Speed), with easing / bounce curves, edge handling and motion blur.
use_for: slide-in / slide-out of lower-thirds, logos and photo cards
slow drift on stills and maps in explainers
continuous scrolling ticker-style background
bouncy entrance of stickers or emojis in reels
avoid: moving a full-frame clip reveals empty edges unless Edge Behavior fills them
fast moves without motion blur stutter
too many elements sliding at once looks busy

params.name: Initial Position
params.typical: [-0.5, 0.5] puts a full-frame layer (e.g. an Essential Graphics lower-third) one frame-width left, off-screen; [0.5, 0.5] = home

params.name: Target Position
params.typical: [0.5, 0.5] = home (default [0.5, 0.25] = moved up a quarter frame)

params.name: Mode
params.does: two modes per Film Impact keywords, Continuous (travels from Initial Position along Direction at Speed) and Destination (Initial -> Target Position); index order unverified, 0 may be Continuous

params.name: Direction
params.does: travel angle for the continuous mode (degrees)

params.name: Speed
params.does: travel speed for the continuous mode

params.name: Overshoot
params.does: overshoot past the target before settling (Type 0 ease curve, assumed)

params.name: Edge Behavior
params.does: how uncovered edges are filled (dropdown 0..3, labels not harvested)

cards.name: RGB Split

use_for: glitch hit on a beat drop or hard cut in reels
punchy 'breaking' / reveal moment in political explainers
subtle lens fringing on trailer titles

3D flip transition between two explainer graphics
tilted perspective photo cards in documentary montages
